empty: No model monitors yet. Click + to create one.
iqNow: Candy test: ask every credential the IQ question
iqDumbNoAnswerHint: Candy question got no readable number

form.name: Name
form.namePlaceholder: Give it a name, usually the model name
form.nameHint: A label to identify this task, usually the model name.
form.targetEmpty: No matching combination. Give a channel a credential and a model first.
form.targetHint: Each pick means "probe this model on this channel with this credential". Picking every credential of a channel/model pair leaves no exclusions, so credentials added later are monitored too; picking only some keeps the rest out of the round.
form.intervalHint: How long one full round takes: every credential is probed once per interval. The interval is divided across the credentials so only one upstream call is made at a time. Each probe is offset by a small jitter (up to ±30s, and never more than a quarter of the interval) so separate tasks do not hit upstream together.
form.windowHint: Pick no weekday to probe all day; with weekdays selected, probing happens only inside the window and is skipped outside it.
form.windowSameDay: The end hour is exclusive; equal start and end means all day.
form.windowCrossMidnight: A start later than the end crosses midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 05:00 next day.

toast.iqPartialFailed: {count} more failed to respond, so no IQ verdict
